title: Behaviour analysis for large language model-driven agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32087v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding language-agent behaviour requires learning how actions are organised across a trajectory and how this organisation relates to context and outcomes. We propose a general framework that connects data-driven behavioural discovery with analysis and experimental investigation. Categories developed from recorded activity define what is measured. Analyses preserve the behaviours' positions in the process and express their relationships as interpretable hypotheses. Statistical assessment and tests in held-out contexts examine the strength and scope of the evidence. Experiments, including prompt steering, then test how behaviour and outcomes change under deliberately varied conditions. A study of iterative self-reflection illustrates how discovery, dependency learning and prompt comparisons can inform one another. We develop this approach for trajectories of varying length, event order and agent roles, and identify advances in codin

translated_title: 面向大语言模型驱动智能体的行为分析
translated_abstract: 理解语言智能体的行为需要学习动作如何在整个轨迹中被组织，以及这种组织如何与情境和结果相关联。我们提出了一个通用框架，将数据驱动的行为发现与分析及实验研究相结合。从记录的活动中开发的类别定义了所要测量的内容。分析保留了行为在过程中的位置，并将其关系表达为可解释的假设。统计评估和在保留情境中的测试检验了证据的强度和范围。随后，包括提示引导在内的实验测试了行为和结果在刻意变化的条件下如何改变。一项关于迭代式自我反思的研究展示了行为发现、依赖关系学习和提示比较如何能够相互启发。我们针对不同长度、事件顺序和智能体角色的轨迹发展了这一方法，并识别了在编码……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一个将数据驱动的行为发现、可解释的依赖关系分析与实验验证（含提示引导）相结合的通用框架，用于理解大语言模型驱动智能体在轨迹中如何组织行为及其与情境和结果的关系。
en_tdlr: Proposes a general framework that combines data-driven behavioral discovery, interpretable dependency analysis, and experimental validation (including prompt steering) to understand how LLM-driven agents organize actions across trajectories and how this organization relates to context and outcomes.
